trust_decision.summary: SP-side acceptance of a SAML login Response whose first (encrypted) assertion is unsigned: the 'no signature' check treats any ds:Signature anywhere in the document (e.g. on a different, plaintext assertion) as covering the whole message, instead of requiring the Response root to be signed; decided in the broker SAMLEndpoint and in the SAML servlet adapter.

landing_point.why: Keycloak-as-SP (SAML identity brokering) is the server-side consumer of encrypted assertions; the hasNoSignatureWhenRequired line that consults containsUnencryptedSignature is the obvious signature decision after decryptAssertion at :573.
